description: This header file defines the em_net_node_t class, which provides static methods for managing and manipulating network tree data structures related to a network configuration. It includes functions for retrieving, cloning, converting to JSON, and accessing elements within network nodes. The class is part of a network management module for handling em_network_node_t structures.

classes.name: em_net_node_t
classes.description: A class providing static utility functions for managing network node data structures, including serialization, cloning, and tree traversal.

methods.name: get_network_tree_by_file
methods.description: Reads network configuration from a file and constructs a network tree.

methods.name: get_network_tree
methods.description: Processes a buffer to extract the network tree.

methods.name: clone_network_tree
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a network tree starting from a specified node.

methods.name: clone_network_tree_for_display
methods.description: Clones a network tree for display purposes, with options to collapse nodes.

methods.name: get_node_from_node_ctr
methods.description: Retrieves a network node based on display counter.

methods.name: get_network_tree_node
methods.description: Parses a JSON object to populate a network tree node structure.

methods.name: get_child_node_at_index
methods.description: Returns the child node at a specific index from a parent node.

methods.name: get_node_display_position
methods.description: Calculates and returns the display position of a network node.

methods.name: get_node_scalar_value
methods.description: Retrieves the scalar value associated with a network node.

methods.name: get_node_array_value
methods.description: Returns the value from a node array based on data type.

methods.name: set_node_scalar_value
methods.description: Sets the scalar value for a network node based on a format string.

methods.name: set_node_array_value
methods.description: Updates a node array with a formatted value.

methods.name: get_node_type
methods.description: Returns the type of a network node.

methods.name: free_node_value
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a node's value string.

methods.name: free_network_tree
methods.description: Frees the entire network tree structure.

methods.name: free_network_tree_node
methods.description: Frees a network tree node.

methods.name: network_tree_to_json
methods.description: Converts a network tree into a JSON representation.

methods.name: network_tree_node_to_json
methods.description: Converts a network node into a JSON object.

methods.name: get_network_tree_string
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the network tree.

methods.name: void free_network_tree_string(char * str)
methods.description: Frees the string memory used for the network tree string.

methods.name: get_network_tree_node_string
methods.description: Populates a string with network node information.

methods.name: get_network_tree_by_key
methods.description: Retrieves a network tree node by a key.

methods.name: em_net_node_t
methods.description: Constructor for the network node class.

methods.name: ~em_net_node_t
methods.description: Destructor for the network node class.
